projectDescription: A puzzle game where you factor numbers by sliding Fibonacci tiles through Zeckendorf identities — playable on desktop and in the browser.
keyFeatures: Four value-preserving moves: Split, Merge, Carry (horizontal and vertical)
BFS-powered Hint button and animated Solve playback
Optimal move count shown for every puzzle
Undo / Redo / Reset — every move is reversible
Runs on desktop (Python/pygame) and in the browser (pygbag/WebAssembly)
Confetti win screen with stats overlay
Collapsible move log and live HUD (moves / time / best)
publicApiSurface: python main.py — launch the desktop game
pygbag main.py — serve the browser build locally
pygbag --build main.py — produce a static web bundle in build/web/
Keyboard: U (Undo), R (Redo), H (Hint), N (New puzzle), Esc (Menu)
Button bar: Undo · Redo · Reset · Hint · Solve · New · Sound · Log · Menu
